scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared-types && npm run build --workspace apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared-types && npm run build:web --workspace apps/mobile
scripts.build:admin: npm run build:shared-types && npm run build --workspace apps/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/mobile && npm run lint --workspace apps/admin
